scope: Selected source-checked study families; incomplete coverage. No automatic title, author or citation-based clustering. A shared study identity does not make every report the same analysis or participant subset.

families.label: Johns Hopkins MDD waiting-list trial
families.note: The primary report and 12-month follow-up describe the same trial cohort. Follow-up does not provide a new randomized comparison.

evidence.basis: Methods and introduction identify follow-up of the previously reported Davis trial.

families.label: Johns Hopkins smoking cessation pilot cohort
families.note: The 2017 report follows the original 15-person pilot. Do not combine their sample sizes as independent cohorts. The later randomized smoking trial is separate.

evidence.basis: Introduction identifies the original 2014 pilot report and cohort.
Methods explicitly describe longer follow-up of that pilot cohort.

families.label: EMBRACE depression neuroimaging trial
families.note: These are protocol documents, including an earlier preprint. The preprint and published protocol describe different design versions; preserve the version-specific details. Neither is a completed results report.

evidence.basis: Publisher-deposited preprint metadata explicitly identifies NCT06072898.
Trial registration and administrative information identify NCT06072898 and protocol version 5.
